'''Serimirl''' was a mysterious [[near-Human]] loyal to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. She was installed as the head of one of the Hutt's dummy corporations in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. After Jabba was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], she removed potential sympathizers to her rivals from her [[Serimirl's organization|organization]] and pulled it back to wait and see what would happen.

Eventually, Serimirl discovered members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] contributed to his death and vowed revenge against them. Following the formation of the Alliance's [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], members of governments allied with the Republic were killed under her direction.

==Biography==
"Serimirl," a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] term commonly translated to "allegiant," was the adopted name of a young [[near-Human]] criminal. An individual of mysterious origin, she was installed by the Hutt [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] as the head of his largest dummy company in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="GG11" /> around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'' states that Serimirl was installed as the leader of a dummy company eight years before the two years after [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Death/Legends|death]], which is dated to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the installation must have occurred around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> The Hutt was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date" /> Though the Hutt was killed by a [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|member]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> Serimirl assumed that it was the work of a rival clan. Acting on what she assumed, Serimirl purged her [[Serimirl's organization|organization]] of anyone who could potentially be a sympathizer to her rivals. When the purging concluded, Serimirl temporarily withdrew her organization to adopt a wait and see approach.<ref name="GG11" />

The crime boss eventually learned that Jabba was killed by the members of the Rebel Alliance and vowed to enact revenge against those who had betrayed the Hutt's legacy by forming their own organizations, even though she was a hypocrite in doing exactly that.<ref name="GG11" /> After the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] was formed by the Alliance,<ref name="HtE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Serimirl's vendetta against those Rebels disrupted the Republic governing on many of its [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. Her direction led to the deaths of members of various Republic-allied governments, sowing mutual discontent and suspicion among the government's member worlds.<ref name="GG11" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Jabbabody.png|thumb|right|350px|The death of Jabba (pictured) made Serimirl vow to kill the people responsible for it.]]
Serimirl was refined, but dangerous when crossed. The crime boss adapted quickly to changing circumstances and was seen as capable. She was charming and had reported seductive abilities, both of which were only matched by her grace in pressuring situations. By the time of Jabba's death, Serimirl had established herself with a personal devotion to Jabba, whom she served with firm loyalty, and a hatred of his opponents.<ref name="GG11" /> 

She vowed to kill the Hutt's "Rebel murderers" and eliminate those who formed their own factions, in her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] betraying Jabba's legacy. Though she didn't kill the people responsible for Jabba's death, Serimirl made good on the promise by eliminating New Republic members. She was content waging a private war with the Republic. No one was sure of the mysterious Serimirl's [[Species/Legends|species]], though it was apparent it was near-Human. She had horned ridges on her forehead and chin, light skin, and [[Hair/Legends|hair]] dark in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="GG11" />

==Skills and abilities==
Serimirl was not the most powerful out of those who made profit from Jabba's death, but she was well protected and capable of defending herself. When fighting, the near-Human would dodge and had proficiency in using a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Serimirl was skilled in seduction, even reputed to have abilities with it, and persuasion. She held knowledge on business, cultures, [[Economics/Legends|economics]], and intimidation, and had street intelligence. The crime boss also utilized conning, commanding, and bargaining.<ref name="GG11" />

==Equipment==
Serimirl used a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. She carried 12,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on her person. At some point in her life, the crime boss wore a low-collared, light-colored [[Clothing/Legends|top]] with dark sleeves, dark wristbands, and a necklace.<ref name="GG11" />

==Behind the scenes==
Serimirl was mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]'', a [[1994]] supplement book to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published by [[West End Games]]. The book was written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and the character's illustration was done by [[Mike Vilardi]].<ref name="GG11" />
